OneDrive._comment: Application (client) ID of VaultGuard's Azure AD app registration used for personal Microsoft account sign-in (public client, no secret). Business/work accounts still register their own app via Settings.

Sso._comment: Sign in with any OIDC identity provider (Google, Microsoft Entra ID / Azure AD, ADFS in OIDC mode, Okta, Keycloak, ...) - verifies the user's email so the login screen's profile picker can select the right account faster; it never touches the master password (see SsoConfiguration.cs's doc comment). Empty list by default: no SSO button appears until at least one provider below has an Id/ClientId/Authority. Each entry needs a 'Desktop app' / public native OAuth client from that IdP (separate from any Web application client used by VaultGuard.Web) - most IdPs need no ClientSecret for this client type since the loopback+PKCE flow doesn't require one; Google is a known exception and does require one even for its 'Desktop app' client type. No redirect URI needs registering - the app binds an ephemeral http://127.0.0.1:<port> loopback listener per sign-in attempt. See docs/SSO.md.

Sentry._comment: Set Dsn to your Sentry project DSN to enable error reporting. Can also be set at runtime via Settings → About → Error Reporting.
